entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt: please design a progressive web app that can host freely either with github page or cloudflare free tier with auth from supabase using google with qr code scanner to scan the qr code for the download page (sample decoded url: http://13.251.17.127/tanita/selftestfitnesscorner/?player_id=20658833&language=en) to download the report (as attached), with gemini api using gemini 3.5 flash lite to do ocr on parsing the measured body data and store on the user mobile phone. The app should also plot the user data as interactive graphs like other health app (I personally want the parsed data can sync with samsung health easily but that is a plus) you can ref to samsung health design. Apart from  qr scanner I would like to allow user to share pdf or image to the app so it skip the fetching and qr decode and directly pass the attachment to gemini for record.  Find a way to allow me on putting the gemini api key safely. So user cannot get the key from the app. I will later add the key, please help me to build a decent app and push to github. I prefer the app ui is well design and intuitive that can adapt to both portrait and landscape aspect ratio on mobile devices.
